about: Two correlated normal posteriors. The result line under the difference figure gives corr, the SD of the difference with corr and independent, and pi_AB with corr and independent; the read-out repeats corr, pi_AB and the independent pi_AB; the formula at these settings has 11 numbers (SD_A, SD_B, 2, corr, SD_A, SD_B, SD of the difference, gap, SD of the difference, z, pi_AB); the slider's note names its end, .95. Ported from v1's correlation-box cases (corr50, corr-plus-sites, corr-minus-sites, corr-unequal, corr-negative-means, corr-clamped, corr-minus95) without deeper=corr, which v3 does not have: the box is the app. In corr50 the core read-out's independent pi_AB is the result line's independent value, and the slider, figure and table indices count this app's own (the correlation slider is the fifth slider; the difference figure and its table are the third). Probabilities are rows of the base-R oracle (oracle-pairwise, pairDirection); settings, the gap, the SDs of the difference and z come from v1's frozen registry (settings.*, cf.pair.*). New in v3: the presets independent, corr95 and shared-mean, an update case, and the shared prior mean. With equal SEs the shared prior mean cancels from the difference, so its pi_AB is Phi(B(y_A - y_B)/sqrt(2 B SE^2)) = Phi(.04/sqrt(.016)) = Phi(sqrt(.1)), whatever the SD of the prior mean: the same value as Phi(.2/sqrt(.4)) at means .30 and .10 with SDs .20 and .60, which the oracle row and the registry give independently; z is sqrt(.1) for the same reason. The model's other numbers (the correlation .645, the posterior means and SDs) have no golden row yet; they are read back by the general rules only. The model's posterior is engine sharedMeanPosterior when the prior mean is uncertain (case shared-mean) and, with its SD at 0, the known-mean limit, engine normalPosterior with correlation 0 (case shared-known-mean), so both branches are pinned.

expect.value: k, the share kept, is the weight each posterior puts on its own estimate, given the prior mean; the rest goes to the prior mean. Given both estimates the prior mean has variance v = ⟨v⟩ (SD ⟨sdv⟩), and both true values lean on it, so they move together. Posterior means ⟨ma⟩ and ⟨mb⟩, SDs ⟨sa⟩ and ⟨sb⟩.

cases.about: The shared-prior-mean model with the SD of the prior mean at 0 (the prior mean known): the correlation is 0 and the result line takes its corr-0 form, while pi_AB is still Phi(sqrt(.1)). With the prior mean known nothing is shared: the model note and the read-out say the two posteriors are independent. This is the branch without sharedMeanPosterior (which takes an uncertain prior mean only): each unit's normal posterior around the known prior mean (engine normalPosterior).
